// diagnostic E1232

Jet.MonorepoFetchFailed

A monorepo source could not be fetched.

What

A monorepo source could not be fetched.

Why

Resolving a monorepo package fetches the source's workspace index and materializes only the addressed subtree; both the sparse subtree checkout and the full-clone fallback failed.

Fix

Correct the source URL and revision in `package.jet`, then run `jet fetch` again.
